Definition

For a smooth left action $\theta :G\times M\to M$ and $p\in M$, the orbit map is $\theta ^{(p)}:G\to M$, $\theta ^{(p)}(g)=g\cdot p$. Its image is $G\cdot p$ and $(\theta ^{(p)})^{-1}(p)$ is the isotropy group $G_p$.
